```artifact
Feature: Prescription and Consultation Request Management

  Scenario: Ensure a single Consultation Request generates one prescription
  Given a valid Patient Consultation Request
  When the request is processed
  Then a single prescription should be generated

  Scenario Outline: Prescription mapping to Consultation Request
  Given a valid Consultation Request with <data>
  When the request is processed
  Then a single prescription should be mapped to the request

  Examples:
    | Consultation Request ID | Expected Prescription ID |
    | CR001                  | P001                     |
    | CR002                  | P002                     |

  Scenario: Ensure a single Chemist receives one prescription
  Given a valid Prescription
  When the prescription is processed
  Then a single Chemist should receive the prescription

  Scenario Outline: Chemist mapping to Prescription
  Given a valid Prescription with <data>
  When the prescription is processed
  Then a single Chemist should be mapped to the prescription

  Examples:
    | Prescription ID | Chemist ID |
    | P001            | C001       |
    | P002            | C002       |

  Scenario: Ensure a single Lab receives one prescription
  Given a valid Prescription
  When the prescription is processed
  Then a single Lab should receive the prescription

  Scenario Outline: Lab mapping to Prescription
  Given a valid Prescription with <data>
  When the prescription is processed
  Then a single Lab should be mapped to the prescription

```
